set.body: Dogfood evidence from explicit first-level reference work bd-01M1W5SDCAYQZKGMAHCHPVWVFC: lightweight Nifti.writeVec currently hard-codes pixdim[4]=1 and NiftiWriteOptions only declares spatial units/system; NiftiHeader does not expose xyzt_units or toffset. Native image/dataset owner: define typed temporal units, step and origin for IO, preserving distinction between stored volume timestamps and effective first-level sampling reference. Acceptance: public write/read round-trip TR2 and nonzero origin with explicit second/millisecond units, malformed/nonfinite declarations refused, 3D defaults unchanged, independent NIfTI header bytes/reader evidence, relevant consumers and platforms verified. Current first-level reference test takes TR from typed RunInput; this must not be mistaken for temporal metadata written to its test image. Do not infer slice timing or force an fMRI-only interpretation of a generic image time axis.
set.title: Preserve explicit temporal sampling metadata in NIfTI IO
